cues.en: Today, we're going to look at the complex causes behind motorcycle accidents and one accident in particular,
cues.zh: 今天，我们来看看摩托车事故背后的复杂原因，尤其是一种事故，

cues.en: the SMIDC.
cues.zh: 也就是 SMIDSY。

cues.en: We're not here to teach you how to ride, but what we are going to do is to show you how to identify
cues.zh: 我们不是来教你如何骑车的，而是要向你展示如何识别

cues.en: and avoid the accident.
cues.zh: 并避免这种事故。

cues.en: This is not a training course.
cues.zh: 这不是培训课程。

cues.en: This is Crash Course.
cues.zh: 这是《Crash Course》。

cues.en: My name's Duncan MacKillop, and I'm an advanced riding instructor.
cues.zh: 我叫 Duncan MacKillop，是一名高级骑行教练。

cues.en: And over the years that I've been riding, I've also done a lot of research into the causes of accidents.
cues.zh: 在我骑车的这些年里，我也对事故原因做了大量研究。

cues.en: In that time, I myself have suffered two smidzy type crashes. And let me tell you, they hurt a lot and they don't do your motorbike much good either.
cues.zh: 在那段时间里，我自己经历过两次 SMIDSY 类事故。跟你说，那真的很疼，对摩托车也没什么好处。

cues.en: Today, we're going to be looking at an accident that's so popular, it's got its own nickname,
cues.zh: 今天，我们要看一种事故，它太常见了，甚至有自己的绰号，

cues.en: the smidzy.
cues.zh: 也就是 SMIDSY。

cues.en: This is Dennis.
cues.zh: 这是 Dennis。

cues.en: He's every man. He's the same as you and me. He's been driving for years and never had an accident.
cues.zh: 他是那种典型普通人。他和你我一样。他开了多年车，从没出过事故。

cues.en: Us motorcyclists tend to think of these people as evil, but they're not. They're just ordinary.
cues.zh: 我们骑摩托车的人往往把这种人想得很坏，但他们不是。他们只是普通人。

cues.en: Today, however, he's gonna pull out in front of a motorbike,
cues.zh: 不过今天，他会在一辆摩托车前面驶出路口，

cues.en: and he's gonna say, sorry, mate. I didn't see you.
cues.zh: 然后他会说：对不起，哥们。我没看见你。

cues.en: Smidses are caused by a number of factors,
cues.zh: SMIDSY 事故由多种因素造成，

cues.en: the first of which is looming.
cues.zh: 第一个因素是迫近效应。

cues.en: An oncoming motorcycle starts very small in our field division and stays very small for a long time. And then, at the last minute, it gets very big very quickly.
cues.zh: 迎面驶来的摩托车在我们的视野中一开始很小，并且会长时间保持很小。然后到最后时刻，它会非常迅速地变得很大。

cues.en: This surprises the driver and causes him to slam on the brakes.
cues.zh: 这会让司机措手不及，猛踩刹车。

cues.en: In this clip, we've put a rider at the other end of the car park. And from our point of view, just look how small he is.
cues.zh: 在这段视频里，我们把一名骑手安排在停车场的另一头。从我们的视角看，他显得非常小。

cues.en: He stays small for a long, long time as he comes towards us,
cues.zh: 他朝我们过来时，会在很长、很长时间里一直显得很小，

cues.en: and at the last minute, gets very big
cues.zh: 而在最后一刻，他会变得非常大，

cues.en: very quickly.
cues.zh: 非常快。

cues.en: So that's looming. Another possible cause of the accident
cues.zh: 所以这就是迫近效应。事故的另一个可能原因

cues.en: is camouflage.
cues.zh: 是伪装。

cues.en: To understand camouflage,
cues.zh: 要理解伪装，

cues.en: let's have a look at the difference between a car and a motorcycle.
cues.zh: 我们来看看汽车和摩托车之间的差别。

cues.en: The car has a very strong outline, big slabs of color, strong inclusions like radiator grills and windscreens, etcetera. It's a big and imposing object.
cues.zh: 汽车有非常鲜明的轮廓，大片色块，还有散热器格栅、挡风玻璃等强烈特征。它是一个庞大而醒目的物体。

cues.en: A motorcycle, on the other hand, perhaps doesn't have such a strong outline because it's made up of lots of smaller parts. The orange of the indicators, the red of the mudguard, the silver of the forks, and so on.
cues.zh: 而摩托车可能没有那么鲜明的轮廓，因为它由许多更小的部件组成。转向灯的橙色、挡泥板的红色、前叉的银色，等等。

cues.en: Even though the rider's wearing a high vis jacket in this case, it may help to break up his outline.
cues.zh: 即便这位骑手穿着高可见度夹克，它也可能有助于打散他的轮廓。

cues.en: What that means out on the road is that where we've got a bitty and complex background, a bitty and complex motorcycle can just blend in.
cues.zh: 这在道路上意味着，当背景杂乱而复杂时，一辆同样零碎而复杂的摩托车就可能直接融入其中。

cues.en: What this means is that because we're very, very small, and because we don't appear to move too much, and because we blend into the background, it means we're camouflaged.
cues.zh: 这意味着，因为我们非常非常小，因为我们看起来不怎么移动，而且因为我们融入了背景，所以我们被伪装了。

cues.en: And if we are camouflaged,
cues.zh: 而如果我们被伪装了，

cues.en: then we cannot be seen.
cues.zh: 那就不能被看见。

cues.en: Remember Dennis, our middle aged driver who's never had an accident? Well, Dennis is just approaching a junction. What he wants to know is, can he go? And he remembers the Green Cross code. Look right, look left, look right again, and if everything's clear, he can go.
cues.zh: 还记得 Dennis 吗？我们那位从未出过事故的中年司机。现在 Dennis 正接近一个路口。他想知道的是：他能走吗？他想起 Green Cross 守则：向右看，向左看，再向右看，如果一切清楚，他就可以走。

cues.en: So let's analyze what happens when Dennis looks to the right. He's looking for hazards.
cues.zh: 所以我们来分析一下当丹尼斯（Dennis）向右看时会发生什么。他在寻找危险。

cues.en: And then he looks to the left and looks for hazards that way too. He then looks back to the right and compares them to the hazards that he might have seen the first time. If he's happy,
cues.zh: 然后他向左看，也在那边寻找危险。接着他转回右边，将其与他第一次可能看到的危险进行对比。如果他觉得没问题，

cues.en: he can go. But remember, all this just takes a couple of short seconds. And is that really enough time for him to spot the oncoming motorcycle?
cues.zh: 他就可以走了。但记住，这一切只需要短短的几秒钟。这真的有足够的时间让他发现迎面驶来的摩托车吗？

cues.en: Because a driver takes so little time to look for hazards, it's our responsibility to make sure that we stand out as strongly as possible.
cues.zh: 由于司机花在观察危险上的时间极短，我们的责任就是确保自己尽可能显眼。

cues.en: So we know that the driver takes too little time to look for us. We also know that we're camouflaged.
cues.zh: 所以我们知道司机花在我们身上的观察时间太少了。我们也知道我们被伪装遮挡了。

cues.en: And we also know that it's our responsibility to do something about it. So to make sure that we stand out strongly, we're going to introduce you now to the SIAM, the Smidsee Identification
cues.zh: 而且我们也知道，我们有责任对此采取行动。因此，为了确保我们足够显眼，我们现在向大家介绍 SIAM，即 Smidsee 识别

cues.en: and Avoidance Maneuver.
cues.zh: 与避让机动动作。

cues.en: So here's the SIAM in action. The rider sees a possible Smidsee situation,
cues.zh: 这就是 SIAM 的实际应用。骑手发现了潜在的 Smidsee 情况，

cues.en: checks that he's not being overtaken either by using the mirrors or a shoulder check, and then starts a positive weaving maneuver.
cues.zh: 通过使用后视镜或回头观察来确认自己没有被超车，然后开始一个积极的 S 形绕行机动。

cues.en: This makes sure that he stands out from his background so that he's much easier to detect.
cues.zh: 这确保了他在背景中格外显眼，从而更容易被察觉。

cues.en: Okay. So what's going on here? Here's me on my bike,
cues.zh: 好的。那么这里发生了什么？这是我骑着摩托车，

cues.en: and there's the car waiting to pull out.
cues.zh: 那边是等候驶出的汽车。

cues.en: Now, we won't ride down. We'll walk down just to make it a bit easier to illustrate what I'm on about.
cues.zh: 现在，我们不骑车下去了。我们步行下去，以便更容易说明我在讲什么。

cues.en: As I'm riding towards the car, what I'm looking for is background movement relative to the car. If there's no background movement, then the chances are that I'm in a Smidsee situation,
cues.zh: 当我骑车驶向汽车时，我寻找的是相对于汽车的背景运动。如果没有背景运动，那么我很有可能遇到了 Smidsee 状况，

cues.en: and I need to start thinking about a SIAM maneuver.
cues.zh: 我需要开始考虑做 SIAM 机动动作。

cues.en: However, if we do see background movement behind the car, then we know that the Smidsee is less likely.
cues.zh: 然而，如果我们确实看到汽车后面有背景运动，那么我们就知道发生 Smidsee 的可能性较小。

cues.en: Back on the road then, the reason we use the cyan is to make it easier for us to be seen.
cues.zh: 回到路上，我们使用青色（cyan）的原因是为了让我们更容易被看到。

cues.en: From the rider's point of view, if we see background moving behind the car,
cues.zh: 从骑手的角度来看，如果我们看到背景在汽车后面移动，

cues.en: then we know that from the car's point of view, we are moving against our background.
cues.zh: 那么我们就知道，从汽车的角度来看，我们正在相对于背景移动。

cues.en: This makes us much easier to see, and it stops the car from pulling out in front of us.
cues.zh: 这让我们更容易被发现，并能阻止汽车突然开到我们前面。

cues.en: If the background isn't moving behind the car, we must perform the cyan maneuver.
cues.zh: 如果背景没有在汽车后面移动，我们就必须执行青色机动动作。

cues.en: The strong weaving motion breaks us clear of the background and makes us much easier to see. The solution
cues.zh: 剧烈的蛇形走位让我们脱离背景，让人更容易看到我们。解决

cues.en: to lowering motorcycle accidents with regards to
cues.zh: 摩托车事故减少的问题，针对的是

cues.en: collisions
cues.zh: 碰撞

cues.en: with cars, which is the greatest cause of motorcycle accident, is to improve car driver training. That is the first thing that they need to do, and that is to teach car drivers to be able to look for motorcycles. That has to be included in their in their training and testing. The second thing that has to happen is that
cues.zh: 与汽车的碰撞（这是摩托车事故的最大原因），也就是要提高汽车驾驶员的培训水平。这是他们需要做的第一件事，也就是教汽车驾驶员学会寻找摩托车。这必须纳入他们的培训和测试中。第二件要做的事是

cues.en: there needs to be a change in
cues.zh: 需要改变

cues.en: teaching young riders how to avoid
cues.zh: 对年轻骑手的教学方式，教他们如何避免

cues.en: collisions at intersections.
cues.zh: 在路口发生碰撞。

cues.en: The present
cues.zh: 现在

cues.en: CBT training does not address that sufficiently.
cues.zh: CBT 培训对这方面的阐述还不够充分。

cues.en: So, we've learned today that it's not the riding but the crashing that hurts you.
cues.zh: 所以，我们今天了解到，真正伤到你的不是骑行本身，而是摔车。

cues.en: We've looked today at a particular type of accident that you might encounter,
cues.zh: 我们今天探讨了你可能会遇到的一种特定类型的事故，

cues.en: the Smidsey.
cues.zh: 即 Smidsey 事故。

cues.en: We've learned that a combination of looming and camouflage
cues.zh: 我们了解到，由于视错觉和伪装的共同作用，

cues.en: can make you much harder to see.
cues.zh: 会让你的身影极难被发现。

cues.en: We've also looked a little bit at the Siam maneuver.
cues.zh: 我们还简单探讨了 Siam 避险机动动作。

cues.en: Why don't go out and practice it? It might save your life.
cues.zh: 为什么不去实际练习一下呢？它可能会救你一命。
